name: Corner Pin
description: The second clip appears as a small card in the middle of the frame, then its corners are pinned out to the corners of the frame one after another, each snapping into place with a springy overshoot that skews the card in perspective, until it lies flat over the whole frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: start
params.description: Size of the card before its corners are pulled out, relative to the frame

params.name: overshoot
params.description: Overshoot of each corner as it snaps into place

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadow the card casts on the first clip
